description: The Tombs of Terror anomalies and plague twists (phase 8 family 06), on family 05's global-rule framework: the rule cards ULDA_702, ULDA_705..ULDA_715, ULDA_719, ULDA_720, ULDA_721, ULDA_724, ULDA_729 (anomalies) and ULDA_801..ULDA_804 (the four plague twists), with the tokens ULDA_801t Surprise! Murlocs! and ULDA_804t Eternal Tomb. The family has no encounter of its own, so this file lists no boss row: the rules are rows of data/dungeon-run/schedule-v1.json "rules" (their incompatibility lists there), scripted in DungeonRunEncounters.F06.cs (ULDA_720 and ULDA_729 are run-layer rules of plugin DungeonRun, with no match script) and admitted in DungeonRunAdmission.F06.cs. This file records where each rule's reading comes from ("rules"); the encounters step of tools/dungeon-run-catalog reads only "bosses" and "rejected". The ten client "Dummy" cards (ULDA_702d, 705d, 707d, 708d, 712d, 713d, 721d, 724d, 801d, 803d: "Dummy Hook Up ...") are the client's own script holders for the player enchantments; they are never created and stay support records.
method: Rule texts are the client's (facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json). Where the text leaves a gap, the hearthstone.wiki.gg page named on the rule was read (2026-11-13) and its statement is summarised ("states"); where the wiki states nothing either, the reading is recorded as an adaptation in tools/restoration-ledger/curation.json "ruleAdaptations".

rules.name: Anomaly - Loot-Filled
rules.reading: After a player plays a minion from hand, the other player is given a Coin (GAME_005); a full hand takes none.

rules.name: Anomaly - Booms Away

source.states: lists the Bomb token (BOT_511t) as the related card

rules.reading: Seaforium Bomber's Bomb, shuffled into the deck of the player who controlled the minion when it died; a run board shrine going dormant is not a death.

source.states: nothing beyond the card text (no Cost range)

rules.name: Anomaly - Angelic Presence
rules.source: client text; client enchantment ULDA_709e2 Angelic Presence ("Attack is always equal to Health.")
rules.reading: Lightspawn's rule for every minion on both boards, recomputed at every aura update.

rules.name: Anomaly - CHARGE!
rules.source: client text; client enchantment ULDA_710e2 Charge!!!
rules.reading: A board aura on each player.

rules.name: Anomaly - Relentless
rules.source: client text; client enchantment ULDA_711e2 Windfurious
rules.reading: A board aura on each player.

rules.name: Anomaly - Whirling Winds
rules.reading: 1 damage to every minion at the start of each player's turn.

rules.name: Anomaly - In the Face
rules.reading: Every hit on a hero is doubled before Armor (fatigue and Bombs included); a cap on one hit (Animated Armor) applies after the doubling.

source.states: names no chest card; lists Master Chest, Golden Kobold, Tolin's Goblet, Wondrous Wand and Zarog's Crown as the related cards

rules.name: Anomaly - Spellshields
rules.reading: 2 Armor for the caster after each spell that was not countered.

source.states: copies of Surprise! Murlocs! are shuffled into each player's deck after the mulligan: one in round 1, one more each round; whoever draws one summons random Murlocs (no number given; https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Surprise!_Murlocs! gives none either)

rules.name: Twist - Plague of Madness

source.states: at the end of each player's turn their right-most minion attacks a random enemy, like Mass Hysteria; this applies to a minion with 0 Attack, a Frozen minion and one that cannot attack

rules.reading: A forced attack on a random enemy character (hero or minion); a permanent or a dormant minion at the right end is passed over.

rules.name: Twist - Plague of Wrath

source.states: when a minion takes damage it gains +1 Attack

rules.reading: The client's Rage enchantment (+1 Attack) for a minion that is still in play after the damage.

source.states: both players start with an Eternal Tomb permanent on their side; when as many minions have died on that side as the entombed minion costs, that minion is summoned, and the process repeats (https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Eternal_Tomb gives the card text "When @ friendly minions die, summon a random minion." and nothing else)
